messages:
marta_cs: Quick sync — AcmeCorp renewal: they want to switch payment method from card to PO and we got a notice their billing signer changed. Can we still get this signed in the next 48h?

nora-am: I spoke to their buyer this morning. They can route a PO, but they need vendor code added to the invoice and a new signer (Sarah Lind, director of procurement). She said EOD Thursday would work.

aj-sales: Confirmed pricing/term stayed the same, no change there. Just the billing path. Do we need a new amendment or just swap payment method on the SOW?

marta_cs: Finance prefers amendment so we have PO number on the doc. Also legal might need the new signer block.

devon-finance: If it's a PO, need a vendor code + tax entity. Can you get the PO scanned and the exact pay-to entity? Without vendor code our AP system blocks it.

marta_cs: I'll ask Acme to include vendor code and scan. Asking them to CC our billing@redwood.ai so we have the exact PDF.

liam-legal: Two quick asks: (1) new signer name + title to match signatory block, (2) confirm if they want countersign or send us the fully executed PO. If countersign required we need the amendment routed through DocuSign.

nora-am: They prefer DocuSign. Sarah wants to sign and have us countersign. She requested we change payment method section to read "Invoice via PO, net 30" (instead of card).

aj-sales: No pricing/term changes; just payment method text. Good to go from sales side.

devon-finance: FYI — our AP requires PO number present on invoice. If they send a PDF PO with number we can process within 2 business days after countersign.

marta_cs: Sounds like path: we draft an amendment that replaces payment clause, insert vendor code field, send via DocuSign to Sarah then countersign. Anyone object?

liam-legal: Fine. Please include signer full legal name and email in the envelope so identity verification matches. Also add a clause: "Payment method change does not alter fees or term unless specified." Keeps scope tight.

bot-docusign: DocuSign envelope prepared (draft). Template: renewal_payment_amendment_v2. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/draft/abc123 (internal link)

marta_cs: I'll populate with Sarah's details once Acme confirms. @devon-finance can you add the vendor code field to the invoice template before finalizing?

devon-finance: Will do. Add placeholder: `VENDOR_CODE: ______` and I will fill once they send the PO.

nora-am: I've asked Acme to send the PO PDF and the exact signer email by EOD today. I'll paste the PO here when it arrives. :thumbsup:

marta_cs: Great — if PO arrives tonight I can get DocuSign out tomorrow morning and should have countersigned doc by EOD Thu. Marking renewal as on-path unless we don't get PO.

liam-legal: One more note — if their new signer is signing on behalf of a different legal entity, escalate immediately. That requires entity mapping and could delay.

marta_cs: Noted. Will flag if entity != current contract entity.

bot-docusign: Envelope status: draft -> awaiting recipients.

nora-am: PO forwarded (see PDF link): https://files.example/acmepo/PO-55421.pdf. PO number 55421. I also got Sarah's email: sarah.lind@acme-corp.com

marta_cs: Received — adding to envelope and sending now. Will post final signed doc here.

bot-docusign: Envelope sent to sarah.lind@acme-corp.com at 2026-03-21T15:12Z. Status: sent.

marta_cs: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for signoff timeline.

liam-legal: Copy for records.

bot-docusign: Envelope update: signed by Sarah Lind at 2026-03-21T16:03Z. Awaiting countersign by Redwood.

marta_cs: Countersigning now.

bot-docusign: Envelope completed: fully executed at 2026-03-21T16:05Z. Final doc: https://files.example/acmepo/Exec-PO-55421.pdf

marta_cs: Renewal executed — PO payment method swap confirmed. Closing loop with finance to process invoice. :tada:
